name: Viktor Rossi
bio: Viktor Rossi (born 31 October 1968 in Bern) is a Swiss civil servant and politician who has served as Federal Chancellor of Switzerland (Bundeskanzler) since 1 January 2024. A member of the Green Liberal Party (GLP), he is the first Federal Chancellor to come from the GLP. A Swiss-Italian dual citizen and native German and Italian speaker, Rossi trained as a cook before earning a teacher's degree in law and economics at the University of Bern. He spent eleven years as director of the commercial training institution Bildung Formation Biel-Bienne (BFB) in Biel, then joined the Federal Chancellery in October 2010, leading its Records Management and Logistics section and later overseeing the GENOVA federal IT project. He was Vice-Chancellor of Switzerland from 1 May 2019 to 31 December 2023 and headed the Federal Council division of the Chancellery. On 13 December 2023 the Federal Assembly elected him Federal Chancellor, succeeding Walter Thurnherr. He is married and has two adult daughters.
